paragraphs.text: 1. THE urgings of the people have impelled me, and by the nearest way I bring you Pusan.
paragraphs.original: प्र मा युयुज्रे प्रयुजो जनानां वहामि स्म पूषणमन्तरेण ।
paragraphs.translit: pra mā yuyujre prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇamantareṇa |

paragraphs.text: The Universal Gods have brought me safely. The cry was heard, Behold, Dubsasu cometh!
paragraphs.original: विश्वे देवासो अध मामरक्षन्दुःशासुरागादिति घोष आसीत्
paragraphs.translit: viśve devāso adha māmarakṣanduḥśāsurāgāditi ghoṣa āsīt

paragraphs.text: 2. The ribs that compass me give pain and trouble me like rival wives.
Indigence, nakedness, exhaustion press me sore: my mind is fluttering like a bird's.
paragraphs.original: नि बाधते अमतिर्नग्नता जसुर्वेर्न वेवीयते मतिः
paragraphs.translit: ni bādhate amatirnagnatā jasurverna vevīyate matiḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. As rats eat weavers' threads, cares are consuming me, thy singer, Gatakratu, me.
paragraphs.original: मूषो न शिश्ना व्यदन्ति माध्य स्तोतारं ते शतक्रतो ।
paragraphs.translit: mūṣo na śiśnā vyadanti mādhya stotāraṃ te śatakrato |

paragraphs.text: Have mercy on us once, O Indra, Bounteous Lord: be thou a Father unto us.
paragraphs.original: सकृत्सु नो मघवन्निन्द्र मृळयाधा पितेव नो भव
paragraphs.translit: sakṛtsu no maghavannindra mṛḷayādhā piteva no bhava

paragraphs.text: 4. I the priests' Rsi chose as prince most liberal Kurusravana,
5. Whose three bays harnessed to the car bear me straight onward: I will laud
paragraphs.original: यस्य मा हरितो रथे तिस्रो वहन्ति साधुया ।
paragraphs.translit: yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā |

paragraphs.text: The giver of a thousand meeds,
6. The sire of Upamasravas, even him whose words were passing sweet,
As a fair field is to its lord.
7. Mark, Upamasravas, his son, mark, grandson of Mitratithi:
8. If I controlled Immortal Gods, yea, even were I Lord of men,
My liberal prince were living still.
9. None lives, even had he hundred lives, beyond the statute of the Gods
paragraphs.original: न देवानामति व्रतं शतात्मा चन जीवति ।
paragraphs.translit: na devānāmati vrataṃ śatātmā cana jīvati |

paragraphs.text: So am I parted from my friend.
